emerging_technology: Agentic AI built on large language models (LLM-based agents that plan, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks)
intended_application: Proposed bounded applicant-support workflow: retrieve approved program information, ask clarifying questions, plan next steps, and request a counselor appointment through a permission-limited tool. Staff approve outbound messages and any record changes. Excludes admission, scholarship, visa and eligibility decisions.
industry_sector: Higher education - graduate and professional/continuing education recruitment. Applicant trust, privacy, accessibility and accuracy matter; international applicants include EU residents; exact legal obligations require specialist review.
business_need: Scenario hypothesis: reduce repetitive inquiry handling and improve timely guidance. Actual demand, response time and benefits have not been measured.
users_stakeholders: Prospective students, admissions counselors, marketing/enrollment staff, university IT, privacy and compliance officers
adoption_posture: Moderate / fast-follower is a course-case assumption, not an official NYU policy.
capabilities_constraints: Scenario assumptions: existing staff and approved content; CRM integration and permissions not verified; vendor not selected. SPS already offers a public chatbot named Violet (D18); its design is not disclosed.
risk_consequence_context: Wrong deadlines or promises can harm applicants and the organization is accountable for what its agent says (D21); unauthorized actions can expose data. No applicant records are used in this assignment. No legal determination is made.
management_question: Should SPS adopt, experiment with, monitor, defer or reject agentic AI for this applicant-support application now, and what would change that posture?
time_horizon: 12 months: decision now, review within one admissions cycle
additional_context: Upstream specialists (C3): A3 incremental sustaining process innovation, compare staff-only / simple retrieval / agent first; A4 Breakthrough with unresolved Potential-Promethean candidacy, Low weight on present decisions; A5 tool-using recruitment agents at innovators/early adopters, observability is the binding factor, fast-follower timing 'prepare and trial now'.
